minutes.headline: Planning Board endorsed an ANR at 603 Mass Ave, approved the Whalen Road site plan, and approved Northfield Road tree removal.
minutes.summary: The board endorsed an ANR plan, closed hearings and approved a site plan for auto sales at Whalen Road with special conditions, and approved scenic road tree removal at Northfield Road. It recommended approval of a self-storage zoning article for town meeting, re-signed tri-party agreements, and discussed forming a master plan subcommittee and revisiting the aquifer protection district bylaw.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board recommended approval of the self-storage zoning article for town meeting after closing its public hearing.
The board approved the site plan for auto sales at 383 Whalen Road with standard and special conditions, after closing the hearing.
The board approved tree removal under the scenic road plan for 759 and 763 Northfield Road.
The board endorsed the ANR plan for 603 Mass Avenue; no opposition was noted.
Members favored a master plan subcommittee of about nine, with a proposed structure for a vote at the next meeting.

why_it_matters: The self-storage zoning article is headed to town meeting with the board's recommendation, so residents will be asked to vote on a change to where and how self-storage can be built.
The Whalen Road approval and the Northfield Road tree removal set conditions on specific properties, and the master plan subcommittee and aquifer bylaw review shape future land-use rules.
watch_next: A vote on the proposed master plan subcommittee structure at the board's next meeting.
The existing aquifer protection bylaw and the DEP model bylaw, with differences highlighted, to be circulated to members.
